markets.title: Will the average daily minimum temperature in Texas (DFW & IAH) fall below 20°F for at least 2 days within a 4-day span before Jan 1, 2027?
markets.rules_primary: If any span of 4 consecutive calendar days after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 contains at least 2 days where the Station Average at Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) and George Bush Intercontinental Airport, Houston (IAH) is below 20°F, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A "Qualifying Day" is a calendar day after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 for which the applicable Station Test is met. The Station Test is whether the Station Average for the calendar day is below 20.

A calendar day is after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 if the calendar date of that day, as used in the Source Agency's climatological records for the Reference Stations, falls after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. 

The Qualifying Days within that span need not be consecutive, and Qualifying Days occurring outside that span do not affect the determination.

The Station Average is calculated for any calendar day as the arithmetic mean of the Daily Minimum Temperatures for all Reference Stations for that calendar day, computed in degrees Fahrenheit and truncated to one decimal place.

The Daily Minimum Temperature is the minimum temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit (unless otherwise specified), for a Reference Station for a calendar day, as documented by the Source Agency in its daily or monthly climatological records for that station, using the calendar-day boundaries applied by the Source Agency in those records. If the Source Agency corrects a documented value prior to Expiration, the corrected value shall be used.

markets.title: Will Stowe Mountain Resort open before Nov 15, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If Stowe Mountain Resort conducts Seasonal Opening Operations in the 26/27 winter season before Nov 15, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Seasonal Opening Operations require at least one passenger lift to carry members of the general public uphill for downhill skiing or snowboarding on resort-designated open terrain. 
The opening calendar day is determined in Eastern Time.
A name, owner, operator, or website change does not change the resort's identity.
If the ski resort is decommissioned, the market resolves to No.

Payout criteria
Season-passholder-only access counts if it requires no additional purchase. 
Any number of lifts, any amount of terrain, and any operating duration count.
If its terrain is split across separately operated areas, opening any portion counts. 

Doesn't count for payout
Employee, contractor, invited-media, private-event, and separately purchased early-access or preview days do not count.
Scenic rides, mountain biking, hiking, tubing, and uphill-only access do not count.
Announced or projected dates do not count. 

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the resort. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

markets.title: Will the temperature in San Jose drop below 40°F in December 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If any hourly temperature value reported for KSJC in San Jose within December 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026 is strictly less than 40 degrees Fahrenheit, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Data for KSJC is available at https://weather.com/kalshi. Temperature values are the hourly temperature observations reported by The Weather Company for KSJC. The market resolves Yes if any single hourly value within December 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026 satisfies the condition; a value exactly equal to 40 degrees does not. Data as published at the Expiration Time will be used; later revisions are disregarded. Hours with no reported value are treated as no observation; if no qualifying value is reported by the Expiration Time, the market resolves to No.

markets.title: HDD at Cincinnati below 1,250.00?
markets.rules_primary: If the cumulative sum of Heating Degree Days (HDD) at Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (station identifier KCVG, WMO identifier 72421) is below 1,250.00 between Oct 1, 2026 and Dec 31, 2026, the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The official observing station is Cincinnati/Northern Kentucky International Airport (station identifier KCVG, WMO identifier 72421). The specified local timezone is America/New_York. The accumulation period includes Oct 1, 2026 through Dec 31, 2026.

A Heating Degree Day (HDD) value measures how far a day's average temperature falls below 65°F. For each local calendar day, HDD equals 65 minus the daily average temperature in Fahrenheit, floored at zero. Days averaging 65°F or warmer contribute zero HDD; the excess above 65°F is not counted and does not offset colder days. For example, a day averaging 40°F contributes 25.00 HDD, and a day averaging 72°F contributes 0.00 HDD, not -7.00. The daily value is the HDD (65) figure published by The Weather Company for the station; if that figure is not published, it is calculated from The Weather Company's "Hourly Mean(F)" value, which is the arithmetic mean of the hourly temperatures reported for that day. The cumulative sum is the total of these daily values across every day in the specified time period.

markets.title: Phoenix · Consecutive days with avg temperature above 90°F (Week of Sep 28)
markets.rules_primary: If there is at least 2 or more consecutive days within September 28, 2026 through October 4, 2026 on which the daily average temperature at KPHX in Phoenix is strictly greater than 90 degrees Fahrenheit, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
A day's average temperature is the arithmetic mean of the hourly temperature values reported by The Weather Company for KPHX from 12:00 AM to 11:59 PM local time, rounded to the nearest whole degree.
Only days within September 28, 2026 through October 4, 2026 may count toward a streak.
Data as published at the Expiration Time will be used; later revisions are disregarded.

Doesn't count for payout
An average of exactly 90 degrees Fahrenheit does not satisfy the condition.
A day with fewer than 18 reported hourly values does not satisfy the condition and breaks a streak.

markets.title: How much will it rain in New York City in September 28–October 4, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at NYC in New York City in September 28–October 4, 2026 is strictly greater than 0.25 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The total is the sum of The Weather Company's daily precipitation values at NYC from September 28, 2026 through October 4, 2026, inclusive, using its reporting days. If The Weather Company publishes a total for that exact period, that total takes precedence. Data: https://weather.com/kalshi.
